summary: Iteration 3 verified all 8 requested checks. Backend: 14/14 pytest passed including new /api/manager/content GET/PUT (manager-authenticated via TOTP), /api/content public GET, anonymous denial on manager endpoints, empty-body 422, all-hidden-types 422, and previously-verified design guidance stream + auth endpoints. Frontend (desktop 1280x900 and mobile 390x844): full customer happy path Ring -> example idea -> 18K Rose Gold -> Create -> Step 5 with OpenAI streaming (~800 chars in <30s), WebGL canvas mounted (canvas 483x400 rendered pixels), viewer metal select swaps material, reset/fullscreen actionable, QR try-on dialog opens with SVG QR (encoded URL comes from `${origin}/?type=${type}&metal=${metal}&tryon=1` in TryOnShare.jsx). Manager login (manager@cleliastudio-demo.com + TOTP) routes to /staff/settings, GET populates form, PUT updates gold rate & payment mode with success toast 'Your changes are now live in the customer tool.' Mobile: no horizontal overflow at step 5 nor with QR modal open; QR dialog fits within 390 viewport (342px wide with 24px gutters). Console shows only benign WebGL GPU-stall warnings; no page errors.

issues:
OpenAI guidance is streamed with raw Markdown (**Silhouette:**, **Design details**, etc) but the

renders it as plain text so asterisks and headings appear literally. Either strip/parse markdown (react-markdown) or ask the model for plain-text output in the prompt.

Parametric ring is a torus + small offset sphere. On mobile the sphere sits at the top-edge of the torus and the whole rig reads as a barbell/dumbbell rather than a ring with a centre stone. Consider centring the stone on the ring's top and increasing sphere size proportion, or importing a proper GLTF ring model.

The rotation is fixed to Y-axis via useFrame with no OrbitControls attached, so the caption 'Drag to turn your piece. Pinch to zoom.' is misleading - user cannot actually interact with orientation or zoom.

action_items: Render Markdown in guidance-copy (react-markdown) or update the system prompt in chat_service.stream_design_guidance to return plain prose without ** or ### tokens.
Improve the 3D ring model: add drei OrbitControls for real drag/pinch, and rebalance sphere size/position so it reads as a ring with a centre stone (or load a proper glTF).
Optional: expose the encoded try-on URL as a data-testid attribute on TryOnShare so QA can assert the exact link deterministically.
critical_code_review_comments: JewelleryViewer: caption promises drag-to-rotate + pinch-to-zoom but no OrbitControls are mounted; only an internal useFrame Y-spin exists. This is a UX contract mismatch.

ManagerSettingsPage.save() sends the entire settings object (including `updated_at` string and any keys the backend does not accept in ContentSettingsUpdate). ContentSettingsUpdate discards unknown fields by default, so this works today, but a strict-mode change would break it - consider sending only the delta.

server.py update_manager_content: after upsert it calls get_content_settings() which re-inserts DEFAULT_CONTENT if the doc is missing. Since we just upserted, this is fine, but returning the freshly upserted doc directly (via find_one_and_update with return_document=AFTER) would save one round trip.

DesignStudioPage SSE parser still splits on '\n\n' and replaces 'data: ' prefix - partial chunks that arrive mid-record still risk being dropped. Not observed in this run (guidance completed cleanly) but noted from iter_2 review.

TryOnShare mobileLink uses `window.location.origin` which is fine for preview but if the preview URL differs from a phone's reachable URL (behind SSO/CDN), the QR link may open a URL the phone cannot reach. Consider a Manager-configurable public base URL.
